design.cue: Please season and roast the chicken and bread, keeping each food on its own plate throughout.
design.premise: The wearer works at one large table with raw chicken on one plate, bread on another, and clearly differentiated soy and vinegar bottles. Both complete plates enter the same oven and then move intact to the neighboring service cabinet, while the chicken visibly changes from pale raw meat to a golden roast.

meta.rule_table: Both seasonings precede cooking, chicken and bread remain on their own plates, and both cooked plates reach the service cabinet.

dialogue.say: At the large commercial-kitchen prep table, pick up the bottle labeled SOY, pour it over the raw chicken breast on the chicken plate, and return the bottle to that prep table. Then pick up the separate bottle labeled VINEGAR from the same table, pour it over that chicken, and return the vinegar bottle to the prep table.

Turn on the oven and wait for it to preheat, then open the door. From the large prep table, pick up the chicken plate and put it inside on the left side of the oven rack. Pick up the bread plate from the same table, put it inside on the right side of that rack, and close the oven.
Cook the chicken breast and the bread slice in the closed oven. When both are roasted, turn the oven off and open the door.

Serve whichever completed plates are still in the open oven, and leave any plate already on the metal service cabinet where it is. If the chicken plate is still in the oven, pick it up, close the oven while holding it, carry it to the metal service cabinet, and set it on top. Then reopen the oven if needed, pick up the bread plate, close the door, carry it to the same cabinet, and set it beside the chicken plate. If only the bread plate remains in the oven, continue directly with that plate.
